name: relaydesk
description: A real-time support workspace for small teams.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @relaydesk/api" "npm run dev -w @relaydesk/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @relaydesk/api && npm run build -w @relaydesk/web
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run demo -w @relaydesk/api" "npm run dev -w @relaydesk/web"
